rows.en: <operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>(<color(4)>Sara<ce()>'s actually pretty stacked, you know. The type that looks slimmer in clothes.)
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>W-wait a minute!! What do you mean by that!? <color(4)>Gainer<ce()>, you pervert! Disgusting!
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Wha-!? How did you know what I was thinking!?
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>(Damn it, <color(4)>Talho<ce()>... "Don't walk around in your underwear," "don't leave your stuff lying around"... She won't let up.)
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>...Sorry for nagging, then. But is that really something to bring up right before we launch?
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>Wh-whoa, hold on! I didn't say anything... I mean, I was only thinking it!?
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>(...I wish he had a little more dignity, like the other captains.)
<operator(17030,2)><speed(2)>(<color(4)>Sara<ce()>'s nice and all... but <color(4)>Marina<ce()> and <color(4)>Hikaru<ce()> are hard to give up too. Can't decide who to go for first.)
<operator(12061,1)><speed(2)>Oh, come on! <color(4)>Roybea<ce()>, aren't you being awfully forward!?
<operator(17030,1)><speed(2)>Huh...? About what?
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>...We heard you loud and clear, you know?

<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>(...Things would be a lot easier if <color(4)>Kaine<ce()> and <color(4)>Tapp<ce()> would only follow <color(4)>D-3<ce()>'s data more. <color(4)>D-3<ce()>'s the real star of the show.)
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Hey, what's that supposed to mean? I'm the star here!
<operator(17040,1)><speed(2)>What in the world is all this commotion, right before launch!
<operator(21030,1)><speed(2)>It seems like everyone can hear what's in each other's minds.
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Could it be... This strange phenomenon might be from an Overskill...
rows.notes: Overskill = King Gainer mind-reading power (Kashmir's Planetta); see glossary_proposals.

rows.en: <operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>Knowing everyone's true feelings... that's not exactly peaceful.
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Strip away the lies and flattery people wrap things in, and of course it leads to conflict.
<operator(19050,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Gain<ce()>, do you have a plan? This is hurting morale.
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Just take out the source. The <color(5)>Overman<ce()> that's triggering this Overskill.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>(<color(4)>Faye<ce()>'s nagged less lately. Still, if she's this naggy now, what's she going to be like when she's older?)
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>... what exactly do you mean by that.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Uh... n-no, I mean, how do I put this... It's not like that...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>...Just get ready to launch! Honestly...
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>This is such a mess. Can we even fight properly like this?
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>People can't act without thinking anything at all. We need to do something about this.
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>Captain <color(4)>Amuro<ce()>, I'm counting on you.
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>Easy, easy, that's enough out of both of you.
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>(Man, they're really acting like kids.)
<operator(10030,1)><speed(2)>What...?
<operator(10010,1)><speed(2)>Who're you calling a kid!?
<operator(10020,1)><speed(2)>Wha- no, I mean, I...
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>(How many times have I gotten <color(4)>Guld<ce()> to buy me lunch so far...)
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>(...Thirteen times. You've bought twice.)
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>Y-you could hear that!?
<operator(25020,1)><speed(2)>You're paying me back later, for sure. ...Don't forget it.
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>(I-isn't now my chance to learn how <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()> really feels? All right, here goes...)
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Garrod<ce()>...
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>W-what is it, <color(4)>Tiffa<ce()>?
<operator(17070,1)><speed(2)>I always believe in you, <color(4)>Garrod<ce()>. Don't worry...
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>(If <color(4)>Roybea<ce()> would only stop chasing women, he'd make a great partner...)
<operator(17030,2)><speed(2)>Heh... So that's what's going through your head, huh? Sorry, but this is simply how I am.
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>Whoa! You heard every word!?
<operator(17020,1)><speed(2)>T-this is no laughing matter! Let's take these guys down already!
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>(<color(4)>Gainer<ce()>... what a fool. He's only lowered his standing with <color(4)>Sara<ce()> again.)
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>...Yeah, I'm a fool, whatever.
<operator(21020,2)><speed(2)>Oh? You caught that, huh? Well, don't let it get to you!
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>(So you can hear people's thoughts... I'd kind of like to know what <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> really thinks of me.)
<operator(23020,1)><speed(2)>I always say what I think. <color(4)>Renton<ce()>, <color(4)>Holland<ce()>... everyone, you're all important to me.
<operator(23010,1)><speed(2)>Y-you heard that!?
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>(Geez... I need to get back in <color(4)>Talho<ce()>'s good graces once we're back.)
<operator(23040,1)><speed(2)>Oh... it's fine, you don't need to worry about that.
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>Hearing everyone's inner voice, huh...
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>This could be a good chance to find out what Go's really thinking, since he never shows it.
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>...
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>Not hearing anything from him... does that mean he's not thinking anything at all!?
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>Honestly, what a farce. None of this would matter if everyone only focused on the fight...
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>Right. This is no obstacle.
<operator(1020,1)><speed(2)>(I can't hear his inner voice at all. Guess that's to be expected of him...)
<operator(6011,1)><speed(2)>Yeah.
